posts.content: TTS-Audio-Suite: A ComfyUI custom node integration for local multi-engine multi-language Text-to-Speech and Voice Conversion. Supports: RVC, Echo-TTS, Qwen3-TTS, Cozy Voice 3, Step Audio EditX, IndexTTS-2, Chatterbox (classic and multilingual), F5-TTS, Higgs Audio 2, 3, and VibeVoice with unlimited text length, SRT timing, Character support, and many audio tools

ai.title: TTS-Audio-Suite: Multi-engine TTS with RVC voice conversion, SRT timing, unlimited length
ai.summary: ComfyUI node suite integrating multiple local TTS engines (Echo-TTS, F5-TTS, Qwen3-TTS) with RVC voice conversion, unlimited text length processing, and SRT subtitle timing. Includes character support and audio editing tools.
ai.why_important: Solves the problem of text length limits and provides subtitle-synced multi-language voiceover generation within ComfyUI workflows.
ai.learnings: RVC voice conversion can be chained with multiple TTS engines in ComfyUI for character-consistent voiceovers with precise SRT timing.

posts.content: Resource2Skill: A general framework for distilling human-created multimodal resources into reusable, executable skills that AI agents can browse, compose, and run, validated across diverse domains including web, PowerPoint, Excel, Blender, CAD, Unreal Engine 5, and REAPER-based music production.

ai.title: Resource2Skill: Distilling multimodal tutorials into executable AI agent skills for Blender, UE5
ai.summary: Framework that converts human-created multimodal tutorials into reusable, executable skills for AI agents. Validated across Blender, CAD, Unreal Engine 5, and music production in REAPER.
ai.why_important: Enables AI agents to learn and execute complex creative workflows from existing tutorials rather than requiring manual prompt engineering.
ai.learnings: Multimodal resources can be systematically distilled into browseable, composable agent skills that work across 3D, CAD, and game engine domains.

posts.content: comfyui_LLM_party: LLM Agent Framework in ComfyUI includes MCP sever, Omost,GPT-sovits, ChatTTS,GOT-OCR2.0, and FLUX prompt nodes,access to Feishu,discord,and adapts to all llms with similar openai / aisuite interfaces, such as o1,ollama, gemini, grok, qwen, GLM, deepseek, kimi,doubao. Adapted to local llms, vlm, gguf such as llama-3.3 Janus-Pro, Linkage graphRAG

ai.title: ComfyUI LLM Party: Agent framework with MCP, local LLM/VLM support, graphRAG integration
ai.summary: ComfyUI extension providing LLM agent framework with MCP server support, integrated OCR, TTS, and prompt nodes for FLUX. Adapts to local LLMs/VLMs including llama-3.3, Janus-Pro, with graphRAG linkage for advanced workflows.
ai.why_important: Enables running sophisticated AI agent workflows entirely within ComfyUI using local models, eliminating API dependencies.
ai.learnings: Can integrate local VLMs and graphRAG into ComfyUI node-based workflows for multi-modal generation pipelines.

posts.content: 3DGenStudio: Orchestrate complete 3D generation pipelines — from text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, to texturing — all in a single visual workspace powered by ComfyUI and external APIs.

ai.title: 3DGenStudio: Complete text-to-3D pipeline in ComfyUI with UV unwrap and texturing
ai.summary: Visual workspace built on ComfyUI that orchestrates complete 3D generation pipelines from text-to-image, image editing, mesh generation, UV unwrapping, to texturing using external APIs.
ai.why_important: Unifies fragmented 3D generation steps into a single node-based workflow, eliminating the need to manually transfer assets between tools.
ai.learnings: ComfyUI can orchestrate full 3D asset pipelines including UV unwrapping and texturing by integrating external API calls into visual nodes.

posts.content: ppt-master: AI turns documents or topics into real, native PowerPoint decks—with native shapes, transitions and animations, data-backed charts and tables on demand, audio narration from speaker notes, and support for your own .pptx templates. · by Hugo He

ai.title: ppt-master: AI generates native PowerPoint with shapes, animations, charts, audio narration
ai.summary: AI system that generates native PowerPoint files with real shapes, transitions, animations, data-backed charts, and audio narration from speaker notes. Supports custom .pptx templates.
ai.why_important: Produces editable native PowerPoint files with full animation and transition support, not just static image exports.
ai.learnings: AI can generate fully-featured native PowerPoint presentations including animations, transitions, and narration while preserving editability.
